value.rationale: The exact all-cardinality series is a motivated quantitative refinement of newly studied capacity-limited domination on cubic graphs. The nonzero-zero-nonzero cardinality pattern for every even circular prism gives a sharp infinite-family failure of gap-freeness and coefficient unimodality, in contrast to ordinary domination, and the near-minimum counts show the exact parity and period-four regimes. These are structural conclusions beyond an off-the-shelf transfer setup or known minimum.
